## Checklist

### Implementation
- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines and naming conventions.
- [ ] I have removed debug logs, commented-out code, and unused imports.
- [ ] **Public-repo hygiene:** the diff contains no secrets, internal document/spreadsheet/folder IDs, internal board or channel identifiers, internal policy thresholds, or staff contact details. Internal values are externalized to runtime configuration or internal documentation instead of being committed.
- [ ] Any AI-assisted code has been reviewed, understood, and adapted to fit our codebase.
- [ ] I have considered backward compatibility and migrations where applicable.

### Testing & Validation
- [ ] I have manually tested the change in a local/dev environment.
- [ ] I have added or updated unit tests for the new/changed behavior.
- [ ] All existing tests pass locally.

### Documentation & Communication
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation (RELEASE-NOTES.md, inline comments).
- [ ] I have updated the Jira ticket status and added any relevant notes.

### Final Review
- [ ] I have performed a self-review on my PR and I am presenting my best work for my peers to review.
